method: Every Markdown file under spec/ (as of 16 Nov 2026) was scanned for answer statements: a status followed within twelve characters by a backticked code, and any backticked snake_case code on a line about refusing, answering or errors. Each was compared with the status and error codes of routes.json. A row is a conflict when a current spec rule names a different status or code than the old handler for the same refusal (ARCHITECTURE O30: the spec governs; the old bytes stay recorded so the owner can choose wire compatibility for installed clients, backend-core:C5).

agreements.subject: expected-actor mismatch
agreements.rule: preamble: Shell obligations outside this model
agreements.specSays: Points dispute routes: 409 account_changed; every other session route: 400 invalid_expected_actor for a malformed value, 403 actor_changed for another account
agreements.note: The lane plan recorded this as a conflict; the merged spec now states the old codes, so no conflict remains.

agreements.subject: restricted project read
agreements.rule: A restricted project is closed on every public route and a paused one stays listed

agreements.subject: evidence download admission
agreements.rule: A scanner evidence grant is redeemed once, and a download needs exactly one grant cookie, a same-origin GET and no range

agreements.subject: signed vetting service requests
agreements.rule: A signed service request binds method, path, timestamp and body digest and is refused outside a five-minute window

agreements.subject: private report size
agreements.rule: A report body holds between 1 and 262,144 bytes and any other size creates nothing
agreements.specSays: 413 after rate admission for a stored object over the limit

implementationDivergences.old: admission.json: no 415 (a non-JSON write is the route's 403 origin_forbidden); a bounded Pages read answers 400 {error: invalid_request, message: "Request body must be a JSON object"} for malformed, oversized and non-object bodies; exactKeys answers 400 {error: invalid_request, message: "Request body has unexpected fields"}; the trace API answers 413 payload_too_large and 400 invalid_content_length

current: every refusal answers {error} without a message
implementationDivergences.old: routes.json POST /api/v1/referrals/code: 401 {error: unauthorized, message: "Sign in with GitHub"}; GitHub failures 503 github_rate_limited and 502 github_unavailable with message "Internal error"; a lost race answers 409 code_taken; 403 origin_forbidden has no message; every other refusal carries its message
